blocks.content: Create a program to count the total number of characters in a string.

items: Get a string input for the variable named text using fgets().
Create a count variable with initial value 0.
Run a while loop to iterate over each character of the string.
Inside the loop, increase the value of count by 1.

blocks.content: Note: fgets() often takes a trailing newline character '\n' as part of the string. This happens when you enter the string input and then press Enter.
Make sure your loop stops the moment it encounters '\n' and '\0'.
